summary_1line: Sugriva returns to Kishkindha, roars a challenge to Bali, and Rama assures him he will recognize and slay Bali during the coming duel.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva stands before the forested gates of golden-walled Kishkindha and roars a thunderous challenge toward Bali's city.
Lakshmana places a garland of Gaja flowers around Sugriva’s neck so Rama can distinguish him in the coming fight.
Rama, Lakshmana, and the monkeys hide among dense trees overlooking the fortified city of Kishkindha bristling with banners and weapons.
